noncomputable def VTask.sumLexLift {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {γ₁ : Type u_5} {γ₂ : Type u_6}
  (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (a : α₁ ⊕ α₂) (b : β₁ ⊕ β₂) : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) :=
match a, b with
| .inl a₁, .inl b₁ => f₁ a₁ b₁
| .inr _, .inl _ => ∅
| .inl a₁, .inr b₂ => Finset.disjUnion (g₁ a₁ b₂) (g₂ a₁ b₂)
| .inr a₂, .inr b₂ => f₂ a₂ b₂
